name: Ticonderoga-class guided missile cruiser (CG-52 on, Mk 41 VLS baseline), as in service 2000s-2020s

must_show: a long narrow hull (172.8 x 16.8 m), flared bow, transom stern, the SQS-53 dome under the forefoot at x 65.4; the transom closed from astern (x -86.4); two shafts on V struts, five-blade screws at x -78.7, y +-3.4 and twin rudders at x -82.6
the forward 5-inch Mk 45 Mod 1 at x 55.4 (node turret) and the after mount on the fantail at x -73.0 trained aft

two 61-cell Mk 41 fields, 9.0 x 6.6 m each, long axis along x, at x 41.0 on the forecastle and x -56.6 on the after deck (cruiser_n, nato_e90_cruiser); the twin-arm Mk 26 at x 41.0 and -56.2 for nato_e80_cruiser

the tall flush forward deckhouse x 20.0 .. 35.6 to the pilot house roof z 21.6, walls leaning in, its two broad forward corners carrying the forward SPY-1 octagons centred at z 15.6; the faces haze grey (#7b8288) in a darker frame ring (#5f666c), not radome white
the after deckhouse: the hangar block, the narrower tower on it (x -28.9 .. -16.2) with the two after SPY-1 octagons on its after corners centred at z 18.4
two uptake groups of three round stacks with sooted caps: forward x 9.8 .. 15.0 (tops z 23.9 .. 25.0), after x -22.6 .. -18.3 (tops z 23.6 .. 24.5)

the big four-legged lattice mast in the waist (x -8.4 .. -1.8 at its foot) with the head platform and radome at z 33.4, the long yard at z 31.0 and the lower yard at the 0.79 ring, the SPS-49 on its bracket out of the after face at z 25.6, its reflector open mesh (half see-through)

the pole mast at x 19.4 close abaft the forward block, braced to its roof, with its platform at z 29.0, two yards and the SPS-55 at the head (z 35); the SPQ-9 radome on its lattice tower at x 22.2 .. 24.4 (platform z 24.6); the four SPG-62 illuminators (two on the pilot house roof, two among the after uptakes)
two Phalanx (Block 1B, FLIR on the side) on raised tubs at the after end of the forward deckhouse, x 5.6, y +-4.2
two Harpoon quads at the stern, the flight deck x -51.5 .. -29.3 with the team ring, two SATCOM domes on the after house (1990s on)

a boat in davits each side of the waist at x -12.0 (RHIBs for cruiser_n and nato_e90_cruiser, 26-ft whaleboats for nato_e80_cruiser), life rafts in rows on the hangar roof at x -28.2 .. -17.8, y +-5.72, lifelines along every exposed deck edge, two anchors in hawses on the bows at x 74.4
